Oliver (Acme): Hey team — since the production push last night our chatbot is refusing to answer routine tax/finance clarification prompts. Used to answer fine. Example below.

Oliver (Acme): Prompt: "How do I report a small freelance income on my 1099?" — Response (from model): "Sorry, I can't help with tax advice." — request_id: abc-req-1721, model: redwood-infer-v1.4-quant

Maya (Customer Success): Thanks Oliver — can you paste full request payload + headers (no PII)? Also which environment (hosted/dedicated/private)?

Oliver (Acme): Hosted, region us-east-1. Payload:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-infer-v1.4-quant",
  "input": "How do I report a small freelance income on my 1099?",
  "max_tokens": 200,
  "safety": "standard"
}
```

Devon (Eng): Noted. We did a quantization + safety tweak rollout last night at 23:05 UTC (canary -> 50% -> 100%). deploy-bot: "rollout redwood-infer-v1.4-quant safety-tune-2026-03 finished 100% at 23:45 UTC"

Aisha (Safety): Can you paste two more examples where output changed (previous vs current)? We need to confirm overrefusal pattern.

Oliver (Acme): Sure: (1) Prompt: "How do I split rent with a roommate?" Prev: detailed steps. Now: "I can't assist with legal/financial guidance." (2) Prompt: "What's the best way to calculate hourly rate for freelance work?" Prev: calculations. Now: refusal. Both request_ids: abc-req-1722, abc-req-1723

Maya (Customer Success): We're escalating to Eng + Safety. Can you share any logs around latency/errors? Also did you notice any auth/billing errors? 

Oliver (Acme): No auth errors, tokens fine. Latency normal. Billing no changes. Impacting 12% of chatflow interactions since 00:00 UTC.

Devon (Eng): Thanks. We'll re-run these prompts against the previous snapshot (v1.3.9) and current (v1.4-quant) to reproduce. Also checking if safety policy mapping was tightened during the rollout.

Aisha (Safety): If repro is consistent, we'll run a targeted eval set and roll back the safety config if it's overblocking. Can you give us a window for rollback (business impact)?

Oliver (Acme): ASAP — it's affecting onboarding conversions. Any temporary mitigations? Maybe route to older model or relax `safety` header.

Maya (Customer Success): We can temporarily route you to `redwood-infer-v1.3.9` in hosted for your org id acme-123 — I'll coordinate with platform.

Devon (Eng): I'll spike a canary test now. @deploy-bot please spin acme-123 redirect to v1.3.9 for 1 hour.

deploy-bot: "request accepted: route acme-123 -> redwood-infer-v1.3.9 for 3600s"

Oliver (Acme): Thanks — confirming behavior improved when we pointed to v1.3.9. Send me any follow-ups.

Aisha (Safety): We'll compile examples and propose a safety parameter patch or targeted whitelist for benign finance/legal prompts. Will post results in this thread by EOD.

Maya (Customer Success): Thanks everyone. Oliver — I'll follow up with incident ticket and timeline.
